text.aria-label: Title text 'Forecasts around four injected transfers'

Subtitle text 'Scored year. For each gate site, the first injected transfer (by identifier) of at least 24 hours that moves load onto the site, from the 100-transfer sample. Each line is the forecast made 12 to 18 hours ahead; the dashed A5 line lies on the plain filter wherever the fit finds no flow. The shaded band is the plain filter's 80% band. The transfers were chosen before any score was read.'
